title: Coal2Diamonds
body:
## Overview

**This plugin introduces a unique mechanic to Minecraft:**

_When a piston is activated facing downward with a magma block beneath it, coal ore is transformed into diamond ore._

## Features

**Automation:**

_Enables players to automate the conversion of coal ore to diamond ore using pistons and magma blocks._

**Creativity:**

_Expands creative building possibilities by allowing new resource transformation setups._

**Simple Integration:**

_Works with standard Minecraft mechanics; no complex setup required._

**Commands:**

_To **enable** plugin - /coal2diamonds enable_

_To **disable** plugin - /coal2diamonds disable_
